name: MiniMax H3 — text to video + audio in 2K (turbo draft + Open-H3-Regenerate-2K)
title: Make a sharp film clip in 2K
summary: Describe a scene and its sounds; you get a 5-second clip with its soundtrack, redrawn at Full HD or 2K with much finer detail. It takes several minutes, so book it ahead.
description:
A 768p MiniMax H3 clip (4-step turbo draft, 1344x768, 124 frames, picture and sound made together) is enlarged by ComfyUI's own H3 latent upscaler and then **regenerated in 3 steps by NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K** on the H3 ref2va model. The refine adds real detail the draft does not have (bark, foliage, light edges) while keeping the scene, the light, the camera move and the soundtrack; it starts from a lot of noise, so small things can shift.

**Size** is the only cost setting: 1920x1088 took about 6 min on an RTX 5090, 2560x1440 about 12.5 min, and both fill a 32 GB card. The timeline books the time of the default size, so a 2K job runs past its slot. Length is fixed at 124 frames (about 5 s at 24 fps).

Needs the node pack **ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate-2K** (1038lab, GPL-3.0) for the one refine node; everything else is core ComfyUI. Sharp curve is off: its 50 curve branches are all zero, so it adds nothing.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 video prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Start with the overall style and opening framing, then describe what happens in order. Name camera moves with their speed ("slowly pulls out"), and describe sounds and music concretely — instruments, tempo — rather than moods.
